title: New Lagos Rising
author: Xanthe Dunmore
blurb: Jude Nakamura, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
